failureStates.message: Couldn’t send a new code. Check your connection and try again.
failureStates.retainedState: Keep the address, old challenge and typed digits. Do not reset the wait until a new send is confirmed.

failureStates.message: Couldn’t send a new code. Try again.
failureStates.retainedState: Keep the address, challenge and typed digits. Use handoff4.auth.resend.refused. Do not reset the known successful-send wait or invent an additional one.

failureStates.message: Couldn’t save your profile. Try again.
failureStates.retainedState: Keep the name and selected photo. For a network failure use handoff4.auth.profile.networkFailure.

failureStates.message: Couldn’t upload your profile photo. Try again or continue without a photo.
failureStates.retainedState: Keep the name and selected image. Offer handoff4.auth.profile.retryPhoto. Continue works with the initial fallback.

failureStates.message: Couldn’t revoke Alex’s invitation link. Try again.
failureStates.retainedState: Keep Alex’s row, prepared link and all other invitation state. Do not show Link revoked.

failureStates.message: Couldn’t confirm that Alex’s invitation link was revoked. Check your connection and try again.
failureStates.retainedState: Keep the row and last known state. Recheck the token status; the request may have reached the server.

announcementPolicy.busy: Announce the action once, keep focus; button label stable, value vo.busy.value. Do not repeat on renders.
announcementPolicy.failures: Announce the exact visible failure once, without stealing focus. Full keys begin vo.failure.
announcementPolicy.resend: Use vo.resend.busy; success uses vo.resend.success once (includes waiting state); availability uses vo.resend.available once. Failed resend uses its exact failure announcement and restores resend action without a second availability announcement.
announcementPolicy.loading: One polite announcement on state entry; no timer announcements. Home resolved announces home.resolvedVO even when empty. Friends/Memories resolve silently.
announcementPolicy.localRootFailures: Use vo.root.leave.refused and vo.root.keep.refused; these are phone failures, never network claims.

approve.clubFull.presentation: Native alert with See members. Reload authoritative membership; do not claim approval or remove any member.

readPatterns.loading: One label is the accessible progress description. Native indicator is decorative, indeterminate and uncounted. Announce once, not on a timer.
readPatterns.failure: Read title, then body, then Retry as separate reachable elements. Announce title plus body once on failure.
readPatterns.formFailure: Read the inline failure message. A warning glyph adds a visual signal and is hidden from VoiceOver. Never reread the whole roster or announce that a membership exists before the server answers.

replaces.otherwise: Earlier copy remains scoped as previously adopted. The new conditional pending sentence does not replace the ordinary initial waiting sentence.
